slices.focus: Local 5 backs standardized first-year materials, common demo checklists, and consistent safety delivery across sections
slices.summary: With a stronger cohort visible as proof, Derek pushes a harder reform: Local 5 and the Western Pennsylvania Electrical JATC back him on standardizing first-year instruction materials and delivery across all sections. He builds a shared lesson binder, a common demo checklist, and a rule that repeat safety topics must be taught the same way across all sections. He frames the change as fairness to apprentices — a first-year should not get a weaker version of core safety based on which instructor they drew — and keeps the spine fixed while letting instructor personality vary in pacing and examples.
open_loops: Rolling out the shared binder in smaller chunks rather than a grand overhaul
Running short check-ins where instructors compare one repeat lesson at a time
Making the demo checklist visible during labs, not just filed away
Using alignment with site expectations as formal justification
Protecting three non-negotiables: binder, checklist, repeat-topic rule
decisions: Derek now has backing through Local 5 and the Western Pennsylvania Electrical JATC to standardize first-year instructor
